"
Cochranella
"
geijskesi
, also known as the
Wilhelmina Cochran frog
, is a species of
frog
in the family
Centrolenidae
. It is
endemic
to
Suriname
. Its natural
habitats
are subtropical or tropical moist lowland
forests
and
rivers
.
